description_full: Enjoy a date night, finish your holiday shopping, or simply take a well-deserved break while your kids enjoy an exciting evening at iCode Columbia! Exclusively for Thunder Hill Elementary School families, children can choose between two exciting STEM adventures: Minecraft Design or Drone Flight & Programming in a Simulator. Pizza and drinks are included! 📅 Friday, December 11, 2026 ⏰ 5:30–8:00 PM 📍 iCode Columbia – 9200 Old Annapolis Rd, Suite B, Columbia, MD 21045 💲 $30 per student Best of all, 100% of the registration fee goes directly back to the THES PTA! Give yourself a night off while your kids have fun, learn, and support our school community. Scan the QR code on the event flyer to register.
